violated_contract: A provider's unit-local speaker label is provenance, not a conversation-wide identity. Reallocating one voice on every upload unit fragments a canonical conversation, while forced nearest matching can merge distinct voices and overwrite manual identities.
canonical_prevention: Bind compatible clean-speech anchors to conversation-local speaker IDs inside the transcript assignment transaction. Persist encrypted bounded scope bindings, enforce same-unit and manual-identity cannot-links, abstain on short or ambiguous evidence, and retain committed bindings across retry, restart and rollback.
